Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.model

Datensatzklasse Building

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.model.Building
Datensatzkomponenten:
buildingInfo - building information
floors - set of floors in the building
rooms - list of rooms in the building
public record Building(BuildingInfo buildingInfo, Set<String> floors, List<Room> rooms) extends Record
Represents a building containing rooms and a set of floors present in the building.

The class keeps an internal list of Room objects and a set of floor identifiers (typically strings).

  • Methodendetails

    • matchesCriteria

      public boolean matchesCriteria(FilterCriteriaDTO criteria)
      Evaluates if this building matches the given filter criteria

      This ensures that searching for a term that only appears in a room (for example "lab") will still return the building that contains such a room even when the building's name does not contain the term.

      Parameter:
      criteria - filter criteria (must not be null)
      Gibt zurück:
      true if building matches, false otherwise

    • matchesQuery

      public boolean matchesQuery(String query)
      Checks if any attribute of the building matches the user query. If no query is provided, the building is considered as a match.
      Parameter:
      query - string to search for
      Gibt zurück:
      true if query is empty or matches, false otherwise

    • getMatchingRooms

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Gibt an, ob ein anderes Objekt diesem gleich ("equal to") ist. Die Objekte sind gleich, wenn das andere Objekt der gleichen Klasse angehört und alle Datensatzkomponenten gleich sind. Alle Komponenten in dieser Datensatzklasse werden verglichen mit Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Angegeben von:
      equals in Klasse Record
      Parameter:
      o - das Objekt, mit dem verglichen wird
      Gibt zurück:
      true, wenn dieses Objekt gleich dem Argument o ist, andernfalls false.
